grammarFocus: 原因、结果与让步从句；may / might / can 的语气差别。
title: A Community Garden Meeting
instructions: 这是一份模拟听力练习，适合B1–B2学习者。听录音前，先阅读10个问题。录音会播放两遍。第一遍听大意，第二遍注意细节。回答问题时，请根据录音内容选择或填写答案。填空题答案必须与录音中的原词完全一致，且不超过字数限制。所有解释均为中文。
transcript:
M: Hi, everyone. Thanks for coming to this meeting about the new community garden. I'm Mark, and I'm the coordinator. We have a few things to discuss. First, the good news: the city has given us permission to use the empty land behind the library. But we can only start planting next month because the soil needs testing. 

W: That's great, but I'm worried about water. Can we use the library's tap? 

M: Good question. We might be able to, but the library manager said we should ask again next week. So for now, we can't rely on it. We may need to collect rainwater instead. 

W: I see. And what about tools? I have some spare shovels I could donate. 

M: That would be very helpful. Thank you. We also need seeds. Does anyone have contacts with a garden center? 

W: My neighbour works at Green Gardens. She might be able to get us a discount. 

M: Perfect. Could you ask her? 

W: Sure, I'll call her tonight. 

M: Thanks. Now, about the schedule. We're planning to meet every Saturday morning from 9 to 11. Is that okay for everyone? 

W: I can come, but I might be late sometimes because I take my son to football practice. 

M: No problem. We can be flexible. Also, we need to decide what to grow. Any ideas? 

W: I think we should grow vegetables like tomatoes and carrots. They're easy for beginners. 

M: I agree. But we should also plant some flowers to attract bees. That can help the vegetables grow better. 

W: That's a good point. So, we can do both. 

M: Yes. Finally, we need a name for the garden. Any suggestions? 

W: How about 'Green Corner'? 

M: I like it. Let's vote on it next time. Okay, I think that's everything. Thanks for your time. 

W: Thank you. See you next Saturday.

grammar.title: 原因、结果与让步从句；may / might / can 的语气差别
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，我们可以用 because 引导原因，用 so 或 that's why 引导结果，用 although 或 though 引导让步。may 和 might 表示可能性，might 比 may 更不确定；can 表示能力或允许。例如：'We might be able to use the tap' 表示可能可以，但不确定；'We can only start next month' 表示允许或能力。
grammar.example: We might be able to, but the library manager said we should ask again next week.

options: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.
Although it was raining, so we went for a walk.
Because it was raining, so we went for a walk.
It was raining, although we went for a walk.
answers: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.
questions.explanation: although 引导让步状语从句，不能和 so 连用。

questions.prompt: Which sentence uses 'may' to talk about possibility?
options: She may come to the meeting.
She can come to the meeting.
She must come to the meeting.
She will come to the meeting.
answers: She may come to the meeting.
questions.explanation: may 可以表示可能性，意思是“可能”。can 通常表示能力或允许，must 表示必须，will 表示将来。因此，只有 'She may come to the meeting.' 是用 may 表示可能性。

options: I stayed home because I was tired.
I stayed home because of I was tired.
I stayed home because I was tired, so I went to bed early.
Because I was tired, so I stayed home.
answers: I stayed home because I was tired.
questions.explanation: because 引导原因状语从句，后面接完整的句子。

options: We may need to collect rainwater.
We may to need collect rainwater.
We may needing to collect rainwater.
answers: We may need to collect rainwater.
questions.explanation: may 后面接动词原形，need to 表示需要做某事。
